reason: It's five minutes from where I already shop on weekends, and I can feel the fabric and have them check the length on me, which is exactly why I stopped buying online. I'd stop in and if one embroidered thobe looks right on me I'd buy it during the opening discount, but just one to start.
objection: I'm worried the designs will be the same plain black abayas or the same heavy embroidery I already see at every shop on Hillcroft, nothing that feels a little more elegant for a woman my age.
would_change_my_mind: If I walk in and the racks look plain or all the same, I'd leave with nothing; seeing pieces with nicer cuts and quality fabric in real life is what decides it.
